lines.beaver_en: How did last night's observation go?
lines.learner: 낙타 무리를 관찰했는데 개체가 모두 열두 마리였어요.
lines.en: I observed a camel herd. There were twelve individuals in all.
lines.roman: nakta murireul gwanchalhaenneunde gaechega modu yeoldu mariyeosseoyo.

lines.learner: 암컷이 여덟 마리였어요. 새끼 곁을 떠나지 않았어요.
lines.en: Eight were females. They never left their young.
lines.roman: amkeosi yeodeol mariyeosseoyo. saekki gyeoteul tteonaji anasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: As expected, mothers protect their young.
lines.en: Yes, mothers always protect their young.

lines.learner: 길들인 개체라 사람을 잘 따르는 습성이 있어요.
lines.en: They're tamed, so they tend to follow people well.
lines.roman: gildeurin gaechera sarameul jal ttareuneun seupseongi isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그래도 처음 보는 사람은 경계하지 않았어요?
lines.beaver_en: But weren't they wary of strangers?
lines.beaver_roman: geuraedo cheoeum boneun sarameun gyeonggyehaji anasseoyo?
lines.learner: 낯선 사람은 경계하는 법이죠. 눈을 흘기더라고요.
lines.en: They're naturally wary of strangers. They glared at me.
lines.roman: natseon sarameun gyeonggyehaneun beobijyo. nuneul heulgideoragoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Haha. Didn't you see any other animals?
lines.learner: 바위 밑에서 독사를 한 마리 봤어요. 조심했어요.
lines.en: I saw a venomous snake under a rock. I was careful.
lines.roman: bawi miteseo doksareul han mari bwasseoyo. josimhaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Venomous snakes are dangerous. What about the sky?
Already? It must have gotten cold.
lines.learner: 추워지면 철새는 따뜻한 곳으로 가는 법이에요.
lines.en: When it gets cold, migratory birds go somewhere warm.
lines.roman: chuwojimyeon cheolsaeneun ttatteutan goseuro ganeun beobieyo.

lines.beaver: 그 밖에 눈에 띈 건 없었어요?
lines.beaver_en: Was there anything else that stood out?
lines.beaver_roman: geu bakke nune ttuin geon eopseosseoyo?
lines.en: A lot of mold grew on the damp trees.

lines.beaver: 비가 많이 와서 그런가 봐요. 결과를 정리해 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Must be from all the rain. Please organize the results.
lines.beaver_roman: biga mani waseo geureonga bwayo. gyeolgwareul jeongnihae juseyo.
lines.en: Sure, I'll put it into a report as soon as I can.
